get.summary: Start Google sign-in (a browser navigation, not an XHR)
Google's redirect target; signs in and redirects back into the site
The collection, newest first; `q` searches titles and descriptions, `tag` keeps one emneord
Whether this visitor can read a recipe from a photo (the button shows only then)

post.summary: Read a recipe from a photo into a draft; saves nothing, not even the photo
post.description: multipart/form-data, the file in `photo`. 200 with `readable: false` when no recipe could be read. 503 when reading is off; 502 or 504 when the provider failed or was too slow.

post.summary: Read the schema.org recipe on a web page into a draft; saves nothing
post.description: 200 with `readable: false` when the page has no recipe data. 422 for a link we do not fetch (not http/https, another port, a private address). 502 when the site could not be fetched or refused; 504 when it was too slow.

post.summary: Read a recipe pasted as plain text into a draft; saves nothing
post.description: Read by the same provider as photos when reading is on (`read_by: ai`, counted like a photo read). When reading is off or the provider fails, the text is split by simple rules instead (`read_by: rules`) and `notice` says why. 200 with `readable: false` when no recipe was found.

post.summary: Add or replace the recipe's photo: multipart/form-data, the file in `photo`

delete.summary: Remove the recipe's photo (no error if it has none)

get.summary: Every emneord at least one recipe carries, with its count, in Norwegian order

post.summary: Make a key; the answer holds the token, which is never shown again

delete.summary: Delete one of your keys; it stops working at once

get.summary: What the approval page shows for an app's authorization request (same query)
One week of the plan, Monday to Sunday; `week` is 2026-W43 or a date in it

put.summary: Set a day's dinner: a recipe (`recipe_id`, `portions`) or a short `text`

delete.summary: Clear a day (no error if it is empty)

post.summary: Move a day's dinner to another day; if that day has one, the two swap

ValidationErrors.description: 422 body: one message per field, keyed by field name, ready to show next to the input.
ValidationErrors.title: ValidationErrors

GroupIn.description: One ingredient group (ST-1962). The title may be empty only when it is the only group.
GroupIn.title: GroupIn

PhaseIn.description: One phase of the method (ST-1962): a title, an optional time, at least one step.
PhaseIn.title: PhaseIn

RecipeIn.description:
Create and edit share one rule set (inventory §3.2). Values are stored trimmed.

The rules that span fields (food.structure.errors: a plain list or every group needs
ingredients, several groups need titles, a phase needs a title and a step) are checked
with the others, so one 422 answers them all: a blank title does not hide a group's.
RecipeIn.title: RecipeIn

RecipeDraftOut.description:
A recipe read from a photo, a link or pasted text, for the "Ny oppskrift" form to fill
in. Nothing is saved: the editor checks it and saves it with POST /api/recipes like any
other.
RecipeDraftOut.title: RecipeDraftOut

TextDraftOut.description:
The draft from pasted text: read by the AI provider when reading is on, else split by
simple rules (food.importer.split_text), and the form says which.
TextDraftOut.title: TextDraftOut

TagOut.description: A tag in use, and how many recipes carry it.
TagOut.title: TagOut

ApiKeyOut.description: A key as the key page lists it. The token is never in here: only its first characters.
ApiKeyOut.title: ApiKeyOut

ApiKeyCreatedOut.description: The answer to making a key: the only time the whole token is sent.
ApiKeyCreatedOut.title: ApiKeyCreatedOut

PlanDayOut.description: A day of the plan. An empty day has no recipe, an empty title and an empty text.
PlanDayOut.title: PlanDayOut

PlanWeekOut.description: One ISO week, Monday to Sunday.
PlanWeekOut.title: PlanWeekOut

DinnerIn.description: One day's dinner: a recipe or a short text, not both. Replaces what the day had.
DinnerIn.title: DinnerIn

MoveOut.description:
The two days after a move: the day it left (now empty, or the swapped dinner) and the day
it went to.
MoveOut.title: MoveOut
